title.value: NL-PS-L4-A - Level 4a: Two minimal GBBs per section

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 4a test patient (NL-Patient-L4-V1 in the test plan), in which every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least two entries with a minimal generic building block (GBB) and a generated narrative, and Medication summary has a narrative summary only, as on level 2. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 4a test patient, and only to that patient. Without a token the server may return the Patient Summaries of several patients; the script then tests the first one. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
